== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Endross is a brutal and formidable combat [[Territory]] characterized as a vast desert wasteland. The landscape is defined by harsh winds, constant thunderstorms, and occasional lush jungles that house numerous predatory species. The environment is so unforgiving that only the strong survive, requiring those who seek power there to conquer through lethal force. [[Travelers]] from this region are often viewed as predatory scavengers who prioritize self-preservation, though some seek out rivals to test their abilities. They possess diverse and often terrifying powers, including the ability to manifest '[[Gates]]'—small, growing thunderstorms that provide increasing access to power but risk consuming the user if they lose control. These [[Travelers]] can also command storm-drakes, small flying lizards that deliver lethal electric shocks to prey. When a [[Traveler]] undergoes the process of [[Incarnation]], they become massive, destructive entities resembling natural disasters. An [[Endross Incarnation]] may manifest with stormcloud wings and bodies shrouded in snakeskin, capable of hovering and discharging lightning. Additionally, the name Endross refers to specific individuals, including a Grandmaster and various [[Travelers]] serving under leaders like [[Malachi]].}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Endross is a vast desert territory characterized as a blasted wasteland where storms are born. This landscape features occasional lush jungle oases amidst the desert, though it is defined by daily thunderstorms involving harsh winds and lightning. The region serves as a location inhabited by [[Travelers]], and members of the Endross are known to wear leather uniforms.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As a Grandmaster, Endross is recognized as one of the four [[Incarnations]] identified by [[Indirial]]. This individual is considered dangerously unpredictable and possesses the ability to summon [[Gates]] that resemble rolling thunderstorms. During their travels, storms can be seen swirling around their hands. Endross is also associated with a massive corpse of a flying snake, and the creatures of their kind almost always view the [[kush'da'rosh]] as the strongest being present.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Endross is an unsophisticated beast and a location that [[Simon]] has previously forayed into, which is protected by formidable guardians. As one of the [[Grandmasters]] who avoided being spiked on the city gates, this [[Incarnation]] once destroyed a mining outpost and attempted to kill [[Zakareth]]. Despite these violent actions, the [[Endross Incarnation]] eventually kneels to King Zakareth VI{{!}}King Zakareth after the [[Elysian Incarnation]] recruited sixteen [[Endross Travelers]]. This entity is characterized by wings composed of black stormclouds that flash with heat lightning.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|"Little known facts about the kush'da'rosh," the Grandmaster said. "First, Endross creatures almost always consider it the strongest creature around.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“That’s four,” he said. “Endross, Ornheim, Naraka…and Ragnarus.”<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|“Then kneel,” the King said. Endross went to one knee in midair, effortlessly hovering.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22" />}}
